title: E-RLT-0106: the rule's own gates on pair making are not a gap, they make one lone vibe scramble the vacuum, pass...
purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0106 in the relativity arena: the rule's own gates on pair making are not a gap, they make one lone vibe scramble the vacuum, pass: with no mixer on three full-key paths (side 16, 'pass', 64 beats) one lone love stays at a wake of at most 27 under 'none' (the working vacuum), passes a twentieth of the slots by beat 15 under 'point' (636,680 or more at beat 64) and by beat 18 under 'occupation' (632,349 or more); the old key reproduces the probe's 'point' wake at all 16 samples.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
